baseline_note: Plants-only remains the policy baseline. Livestock rows are eligible only when feed is property-grown, winter supply is closed and the production population is self-replacing. No single row is universally optimal.
nutrition_unit_rule: All daily Health Canada micronutrient reference values are multiplied by 365.25 before comparison with annual food supply; daily and annual fields remain explicit.

labour_scaling.formula: fixed system + breeding-animal + grow-out-inventory + seasonal-batch tasks; processing setup × batches + per-animal × harvest
labour_scaling.note: Labour is calculated from explicit task quantities and unit-time assumptions. Central task values are planning assumptions bounded by the listed sources; no unsupported fixed/variable percentage is asserted.

seasonal.frequency: seasonal breeding, kidding and winter-preparation cycles

canonical.label: Self-replacing true-breeding dual-purpose flock
canonical.breeding: natural mating with retained replacement birds; no recurring chicks or pullets
canonical.locomotion_and_range: outdoor mobility, range use and forage behaviour are relevant; intake contribution remains bounded and site-specific
canonical.heat_tolerance: not a Grey County selection driver and not quantitatively modelled
canonical.growth_and_feed: slow-growing/dual-purpose planning boundary; no commercial broiler feed-conversion or carcass assumptions are inherited
canonical.climate: cold-hardy reference range for Grey County, with Chantecler selected as the conservative reference
canonical.evidence_status: breed comparison and flock outputs are planning synthesis; local flock validation required

industrial_sensitivity.label: Fast-growing commercial broiler sensitivity
industrial_sensitivity.breeding: recurring production-bird replacement; excluded from canonical ARC carrying capacity
industrial_sensitivity.locomotion_and_range: selection for rapid growth can reduce mobility/range suitability relative to slower-growing birds
industrial_sensitivity.heat_tolerance: comparative heat/locomotion evidence is context-specific and not transferred into the canonical flock
industrial_sensitivity.growth_and_feed: commercial performance is a separate sensitivity and must not be used for the canonical flock
industrial_sensitivity.climate: not selected as the Grey County self-replacing reference
